summary: While held, cast Druidcraft at will.
text: While held, cast Druidcraft at will. Reference-only: Plant Growth (Overgrowth only) once per dawn; Magic action restores nonmagical plants in a visible 5-foot Cube within 15 feet for 1d4 days. Cast Insect Plague once per dawn using your spell DC. Reference-only, once per dawn: Magic action, chosen creatures in 30-foot Emanation save DC 17 Constitution or fall Unconscious for 1 hour; damage or an action to wake within 5 feet ends it. Creatures that do not sleep or are immune to Exhaustion automatically succeed.
